comment: TX_VERSION is an unsigned BIP 441 number; its cost also pins OP_TX's default fixed execution charge.
TX_LOCKTIME is an unsigned BIP 441 number.
Every field, both scopes set to ALL, and default output.
Every field and both ALL scopes in one collated byte string.
COLLATE uses the one-byte and uint16 CompactSize forms at lengths 252 and 253.
The count flags return two inputs and one output, distinguishing their assignments and output order.
CURRENT independently selects input 0 and matching output 0.
ALL emits both input amounts followed by both output amounts.
SINGLE operands are input index first, then output index.
RANGE(0,2) for both inputs and outputs uses start followed by count.
Each output amount and script precede the next output.
The output count precedes the selected outputs.
An absent CURRENT_TAPROOT_ANNEX is one empty value in the default output.
Absent CURRENT_TAPROOT_ANNEX is CompactSize-framed in COLLATE mode.
No executed OP_CODESEPARATOR is represented by uint32 0xffffffff.
A 32-byte push and OP_DROP before OP_CODESEPARATOR place it at opcode position 2, not byte offset 34.
CURRENT_INTERNAL_KEY is the 32 bytes after the control-block header.
The last input and output indices are valid SINGLE boundaries.
A collated selector exposes the fields needed for a CTV-like commitment.
A collated selector exposes the fields needed for a TemplateHash-like commitment without an annex.
A two-byte default-output amount succeeds at its exact varops budget.
The same amount fails one varop below its complete prepaid cost.
The TemplateHash-like collated selection with an annex succeeds at its exact COPY cost.
One TX_VERSION result reaches exactly 32768 combined main/alt-stack items.
TX_VERSION and TX_LOCKTIME exceed the 32768 combined main/alt-stack item limit.
A 32-byte previous transaction ID reaches exactly 8000000 combined main/alt-stack bytes.
One additional initial byte exceeds the combined main/alt-stack byte limit.
A default-output value exactly at the 4000000-byte element limit succeeds.
A selected byte value larger than the BIP 441 element limit fails.
A missing selector stack element fails before mutation.
An empty selector byte string has malformed length.
A five-byte selector is shorter than the complete header.
A version-0 selector longer than six bytes fails.
Byte 2 bit 3 returns the current TapLeaf hash.
An undefined output-field bit fails closed.
Byte 2 bit 6 folds the current TapLeaf hash with a non-empty Merkle path.
Scope value 5 is invalid.
An input scope selecting data requires a nonzero input field mask.
An input field mask is invalid when the input scope is NONE.
An output scope selecting data requires a nonzero output field mask.
An output field mask is invalid when the output scope is NONE.
Output SINGLE requires one stack operand.
Input SINGLE requires one stack operand.
Input RANGE requires both start and count operands.
Input index 2 is outside a two-input transaction.
RANGE count zero is invalid.
RANGE count one selects exactly one input.
RANGE(1,2) exceeds a two-input transaction and never truncates.
Bounds checking rejects a maximum start without wrapping addition.
Scope operands must use normalized unsigned encoding.
A scope operand wider than four bytes is invalid.
A selector must request at least one field.
The direct evaluator fails if its execution context omits the code-separator position; normal 0xc2 execution initializes it.
Execution-context fields fail when their context is unavailable.
Output CURRENT fails if no output matches the current input index.
TX_VERSION preserves an unsigned 32-bit pattern with the high bit set.
A zero numeric value is an empty stack element in the default output format.
COLLATE does not make an otherwise empty selection valid.
Input SINGLE and output RANGE operands appear below the selector, in that order.
A 4,000,000-byte variable field exceeds the element limit after COLLATE adds its CompactSize prefix.
Input and output total amounts succeed at the exact copying plus traversal budget.
Input and output total amounts produce no results when the budget is one varop too small.
Count and amount flags combine, with each count preceding its corresponding amount.
The input total amount fails on uint64 overflow.
The output total amount fails on uint64 overflow.
TX_WEIGHT returns the BIP141 transaction weight as a normalized unsigned integer.
COLLATE encodes TX_WEIGHT as uint32 little-endian.
Witness count and items are emitted in serialized order for the current input.
COLLATE emits each input's witness count followed by its length-prefixed items.
Selecting witness items from an input with an empty witness emits no default-mode results.
Selecting witness items from an input with an empty witness emits one empty collated result.
A present Taproot annex remains the final raw witness item, including its 0x50 prefix.
Selector version 1 immediately succeeds.
A reserved version succeeds before otherwise-invalid current-format data is parsed.
Even a transaction-wide selection requires the complete spent-output context.
Even a transaction-wide selection requires the complete Taproot execution context.
